verified_files.extraction_method: Structured metadata ingestion from NPD FactPages development wellbores (15/9-F-1, F-4, F-12, F-14, F-15S)

verified_files.source_authority: Equinor Volve Completion Composite Logs & NPD Lithostratigraphy
verified_files.extraction_method: Extracted from official Volve completion composite well log headers; verified against NPD lithostratigraphic nomenclature

verified_files.source_authority: Schlumberger MWD / Gyro Directional Surveys via Volve WITSML repository
verified_files.extraction_method: Minimum Curvature directional surveys stations at key 500m intervals and formation boundaries

verified_files.source_authority: Statoil/Equinor Volve Daily Drilling Reports (DDRs) and Well Completion Reports (WCRs)
verified_files.extraction_method: Manual cross-referencing and verification against 1,759 Volve DDR shift remarks and NPT logs
